New form: fold capacity into a single continuous score by penalising not only current distance but also the projected return-detour after serving each candidate (a look-ahead of the residual route), so no separate near-tie branch is needed — instead the depot-distance weight becomes adaptive to remaining capacity, and ties are broken by a slack-normalised penalty rather than a fixed band.
